fixed_s_semantics: Every integer s>=1 is a rigorously defined AD C_s resolver; no convergence in s is required to state the theorem.
uniform_phase_bound: J_N(r)-J_C_s(r) is in {0,1} for every s>=1,r>=0; thus pointwise sampling instability cannot exceed one shell.
uniform_constant: sup_{s>=1}|C_C_s(r)/(2r)-kappa_E|<5/r for r>=1; no sampling-stability threshold s0 is required for the algebraic constant theorem.
pointwise_all_s_stabilization: OPEN / NOT REQUIRED: AJ does not claim a finite s0 after which every C_s event decision is identical for all radii.
arbitrarily_large_fixed_s_phase_changes: OPEN AS A POINTWISE DYNAMICS QUESTION; it is not needed for resolver-robust kappa because the one-layer bound is already all-radius and uniform in s.
canonical_tie_rule: AD uses 2*K>=s^2, so exact halves are selected and have chi_s(r)=0 at that shell; no post-hoc tie rule was introduced.
interpretation: Sampling can alter the local phase bit, but never the asymptotic Enterprise circle constant.
